description: Open Source AI Platform - AI Chat with advanced features that works with every LLM

sources.entry: Onyx Community Edition - Chat UI that works with any LLM. It comes loaded with advanced features like agents, web search, RAG, MCP, deep research, Connectors to 40+ knowledge sources, and more. (Source Code) MIT Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: Onyx is an open-source, self-hostable AI platform that combines a chat UI for any LLM with a knowledge layer that indexes team data from connected apps for search and agent use.
summary.what_it_does: Onyx connects to many applications (the README says 50+, and the awesome-selfhosted listing mentions 40+ connectors) and builds an index of their content along with metadata and permissions for RAG-style search. It offers agentic RAG using a hybrid index, a multi-step deep research flow, and custom agents with their own knowledge subsets and instructions. Agents can use web search via providers such as Serper, Google PSE, Brave, or SearXNG, and can take actions in external apps through external actions and MCP. It also includes a secure code sandbox, artifact generation, and voice mode. It supports self-hosted LLMs (such as Ollama, LiteLLM, vLLM) and proprietary providers (such as Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini), and users can reach it through a web/desktop app, Slack and Discord bots, an MCP server, a Chrome extension, or an embeddable widget.
use_cases: chat with an LLM over internal documents
building custom AI agents with company context
deep research reports from multiple sources
Slack or Discord bot answering from org knowledge
lightweight self-hosted chat UI for multiple LLMs
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash (single-command deploy, as shown in the README; URL is missing in the source text)
Deploy with Docker, Kubernetes, or Helm/Terraform; guides for major cloud providers are linked from the docs
Onyx Lite: lightweight mode under 1GB memory, chat and agents only, no indexing
Onyx Cloud is available to try without deploying
notable: Indexes knowledge from 50+ applications with permissions preserved, instead of relying on live MCP searches
Air-gappable self-hosted deployment with a choice of local or trusted embedding models and LLM providers
Lite mode runs the chat UI and agents in under 1GB of memory without indexing
Same access controls apply whether queries come from web, Slack, Discord, MCP clients, or the Chrome extension
caveats: Full standard deployment has multiple components (vector and keyword index, background workers, inference servers, Redis, MinIO), so it is heavier to run than Lite
Enterprise features such as SSO via SAML/SCIM, RBAC, analytics, and whitelabeling are in the paid Enterprise Edition
License is listed as NOASSERTION on GitHub; the README says the Community Edition is MIT, and the Enterprise Edition is separate
